name: img2img refine (keep composition, add detail)
description: Architecture-agnostic (no EmptyLatentImage - the size follows the init image), so it takes any checkpoint, sd15 or SDXL. That makes it the style-transfer bridge: run a NoobAI illustration back through RealVisXL at strength 0.4-0.55 to land a semi-real render of the same composition, or the reverse to flatten a photoreal plate into illustration. Re-runs an already-good generation to paint in details that txt2img will not render on its own - mud, wetness, torn fabric, runs in stockings, stains. Keeps the composition of the init image. 'strength' is the denoise amount: 0.3-0.4 touches up texture only, 0.45-0.55 repaints surfaces while holding the pose, above 0.65 the composition drifts. The init image must already exist in ComfyUI's input folder (push it with scripts/upload_ref.py). Output size follows the init image; there is no width/height parameter. Required overrides: prompt, ckpt, init_image, strength, filename_prefix (plus negative_prompt in practice - if omitted it falls back to the weak global default 'text, watermark').

defaults.negative_prompt: deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, missing limbs, fused fingers, extra fingers, blurry, low quality, watermark, text, signature
